g.text: Diagnostic alternatives to the adopted moment estimate · no fit is calibrated to ML or to another Mw catalog
a–c: 443 grade-A events. d: only 210 retain one decade after trimming. e–f: 443 events, same frequency gate and source coefficient.
Orange in e marks the original n=1.5 bound. Exponents ≤1.5 are finite-band sensitivity models; extending them to infinite frequency would make J diverge.
